### 1. Request, simulator behaviour
The simulator opens with "I'd like to close my FlexLine to any more draws and just keep paying off what I owe." Target object: her FlexLine; action: close to new draws with a balance remaining; timing: today; authorisation: closing is "your own decision ... when they hand you the step to close the line yourself, you carry it out with the line reference number and the monthly payment exactly as they read them". The simulator is passive: identity details on request; consents if told "something on the line has to be booked, reviewed or adjusted before the closing can go through"; refuses full payoff and AutoPay; never proposes a figure. Identity: find_customers(phone 6025554319) → customer 958604a3…, name/DOB 1981-04-09/ZIP 85016 match.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
Act now, after three agent-side writes. Grounds:
- find_credit_lines: FlexLine Standard, `status: active`, `freeze_reason: ''`, open 2024-01-22, limit 4000.00, APR 24.99, balance 2604.91, minimum due 114.26, `next_due_date: 2026-09-18`, `amount_past_due: 35.21`.
- closing_to_new_draws: "A borrower may close an active FlexLine ... line to new draws, including a line that is past due but not frozen"; draw_period_end_and_closure: "with a balance it is closed to new draws and moves to repayment at once". Balance > 0, so not "closed outright".
- Not frozen: Standard freezes at 30 days past due (late_returned_delinquency_schedule); 2026-09-18 → 2026-10-16 is 28 days.
- The closing tool is the customer's own ("This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `close_line_to_draws_7539d675` and hands it over").

### 3. Object, keys, rows
Line a7e569f0…; ledger via find_line_transactions(customer_id); ledger sum (charges less payments and waivers) = 2604.91 = record balance. Late fees: 2025-07-29 25.00 (due 2025-07-18), 2026-03-30 25.00 (95f4ff09, due 2026-03-18). Courtesy waivers: one, 2025-09-20 15.00 against a returned-payment fee (041198d8). Returns: 2025-09-12 R01, 2026-02-25 R01 (each with a fee entry; no payment carries a related_txn_id to either return → no replacement recorded). Draws: every draw carries a draw-fee entry. Latest payment 2026-09-25 30.00. Personal Loans: one active Grade C loan 1dfd2e82, amount_past_due 0.00, scheduled installment 423.11 (scheduled_installment entries of 423.11 posted), one loan late fee 2026-09-21 21.16. No limit requests on the line.

### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Late fee for due date 2026-09-18 (booking 2026-10-16). Computation doc late_fee_amount: tier late fee 25.00, never above the unpaid part 35.21 → fall-back 25.00. Scope (late_fee_assessment): minimum still not paid in full → "the amount set under this policy". Factors found from the records:
 - late_fee_unpaid_part_figuring (method): unpaid part 35.21 < 100, days late 28 < 30 → smaller of 25% × 35.21 = 8.80 and 25.00 → 8.80. Found from: the line's `amount_past_due` and `next_due_date`.
 - late_fee_balance_tier_share: ledger balance before the fee 2604.91 (500–2999.99) → 0.80. Found from: the line's ledger.
 - late_fee_grace_payment_share: latest payment 2026-09-25 30.00, after 09-18 and ≤ 09-28 (last grace day), smaller than 35.21 → 0.90. Found from: the line's payment entries.
 - late_fee_history_share: late-fee entries after 2025-10-16 before this fee: 2026-03-30 only → exactly one → 0.90. Found from: `line_late_fee_assessed` entries.
 - late_fee_tenure_share: open 2024-01-22 → 32 whole months on 2026-10-16 → 0.95. Found from: the line's `open_date`.
 8.80 × 0.80 × 0.90 × 0.90 × 0.95 = 5.41728 → held to ≤ 35.21 → **5.42**.
(b) Credit-limit review (review date 2026-10-16). Computation doc reviewed_limit_amount: 4000 less 10% = 3600 → fall-back 3600.00. Factors:
 - review_lateness_cut: 28 days past due (≥25) → +0.10. Found from: `next_due_date`/`amount_past_due`.
 - review_personal_loan_cut: active Personal Loan with amount past due 0.00 and one personal-loan late fee (2026-09-21) in the last 12 months → +0.05. Found from: find_loans / find_loan_transactions (Larkspur Personal Loans, named by its official name in the doc).
 - review_returned_payment_cut: returned-payment entries after 2025-10-16: 2026-02-25 only → +0.05. Found from: `line_payment_returned` entries.
 - review_tenure_relief: 32 months → × 0.75 on the whole cut.
 - review_cut_application (method): limit 4000 ≤ 5000, line ≥ 24 months → first 1000 kept, cut on the part above.
 Cut (0.10+0.10+0.05+0.05) × 0.75 = 0.225; 1000 + 3000 × 0.775 = 3325.00 → rounded down 3300.00; floors: balance rounded up 2700.00 (2604.91 or 2600.21), tier minimum 2500 → **3300.00**.
(c) Workout relief (relief date 2026-10-16), booked after (a). Computation doc workout_relief_amount: largest late fee, of equal amounts the most recently booked → 95f4ff09 (25.00, 2026-03-30), waived in full → fall-back 25.00. Courtesy count: Standard allows 1 per rolling 12 months; the only courtesy waiver (2025-09-20) is outside 2025-10-16..2026-10-16 → allowed. Factors:
 - workout_relief_figuring (method): late-fee entries after 2025-10-16 = 2026-03-30 and the new 2026-10-16 fee → two or more → fee less 5.00 = 20.00.
 - workout_depth_share: 28 days past due → 0.75.
 - workout_prior_relief_share: courtesy waiver 2025-09-20 is outside 12 months, inside 24 months → 0.75.
 - workout_tenure_share: 32 months → 0.90.
 20.00 × 0.75 × 0.75 × 0.90 = 10.125 → half-even **10.12**, against 95f4ff09.
(d) Repayment payment (closing date 2026-10-16). Amount repaid = balance on the closing date incl. past due = 2604.91 + 5.42 − 10.12 = 2600.21. Monthly rate 24.99/1200. Computation doc repayment_payment_calculation: level payment over the tier repayment period (Standard 36) → fall-back level(2600.21, 36) = 103.37 (103.56 on the unchanged 2604.91). Factors:
 - repayment_term_by_balance_and_age (method on the term): balance ≤ 3000 and line ≥ 24 months → 24 months.
 - late_history_term_reduction: late-fee entries after 2025-10-16 on the closing date: 2026-03-30 and 2026-10-16 → two → −6.
 - past_due_workout_months: amount past due, 28 days from next due date → ≥ 20 → +6.
 - personal_loan_affordability_months: active Personal Loan with 0.00 past due, largest scheduled installment 423.11 ≥ 300 → +6.
 - recent_draw_term_trim: draws after 2026-07-16: 1200 + 400 = 1600 against the closing-date limit 3300 (48.5%) → −3.
 - repayment_method_by_line_use (method): 2600.21 / 3300 = 78.8% > 75%, draws after 2025-10-16 = 7 ≥ 4 → equal share plus one month of interest.
 Term 24 − 6 + 6 + 6 − 3 = 27 (≥ 12). Payment 2600.21/27 + 2600.21 × 0.020825 = 96.30 + 54.15 → **150.45**.
 Note the review bears on (d): at the unreviewed 4000 limit the balance is 65% → level payment over 27 = 126.88.

### 5. Tool sequence
1. agent: unlock + `assess_late_fee_ba469c06(credit_line_id=a7e569f0…, installment_due_date=2026-09-18, fee_amount=5.42)`.
2. agent: unlock + `apply_limit_review_5d0a2d8e(credit_line_id, reviewed_limit=3300.00)` (independent of 1; reviewed limit is the same in either order because the balance floor is 2700 either way).
3. agent: unlock + `grant_workout_fee_relief_903cc630(credit_line_id, related_txn_id=95f4ff09…, relief_amount=10.12)` — after 1.
4. agent unlocks `close_line_to_draws_7539d675` and hands it over; user runs it with (credit_line_id, repayment_payment=150.45) — after 1, 2, 3. Terminal state: status repayment, draw_period_end_date 2026-10-16, minimum_payment_due 150.45.

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
Root: close to new draws (closing_to_new_draws). Its rule carries three sentences:
- H1 "The repayment payment is fixed only after a line fifteen or more days past due carries a credit-limit review decided on or after its oldest unpaid due date." Record: 28 days past due, oldest unpaid due date 2026-09-18 (draw_period_end_and_closure: "The oldest unpaid due date is the one Larkspur's record of the line shows as its next due date"); find_line_limit_requests: none. Search with "credit-limit review ... 15 or more days past due" → credit_limit_review: "credit review lowers the credit limit of an active line that is 15 or more days past due ... recorded as a decrease decided the day it is made". → write: apply_limit_review. **state-derived**.
- H2 "The repayment payment of a past-due line is not fixed until the line carries a courtesy fee-waiver entry against one of its late fees dated on or after its oldest unpaid due date." Record: no courtesy waiver against a late fee at all. Search "courtesy fee-waiver entry against ... late fee" → workout_fee_relief: "When the borrower closes ... to new draws while an amount is past due, Larkspur grants workout relief on one late fee ..., booked as one courtesy fee-waiver entry against that late fee". → write: grant_workout_fee_relief. **state-derived**.
- H3 "Before the repayment payment is worked out, every due date whose minimum payment is still unpaid past the grace period must carry its late-fee entry." Record: due 2026-09-18 unpaid (35.21), grace ended 2026-09-28 (payments_and_fees clause 4), no late-fee entry for it. late_fee_assessment describes booking a late-fee entry "against the due date it is charged for". **state-derived**.
- H4 (in workout_fee_relief) "Workout relief is fixed only after every due date whose minimum payment is still unpaid past the grace period carries its late-fee entry." Same state as H3 → late fee before relief. **state-derived**.
Order: late fee → workout relief; review (free); all three → closing (customer tool). No hop was pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool or route; the only tool names are each policy's own invocation block.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the closing": excluded by H1–H3 — closing now would record a payment the hub says is "not fixed" (no review, no courtesy late-fee waiver, unbooked late fee); also the workout doc's occasion ("closes ... while an amount is past due") is met.
- Close outright vs close to draws: balance 2604.91 > 0 → closing to new draws (draw_period_end_and_closure table).
- Draw-period-end level payment + past due (the retired base reading): closing_to_new_draws states that for a borrower-closed line "that level payment ... [is] replaced by the repayment payment set under this policy" and repayment_payment_calculation: "Nothing more is added for the amount past due".
- Relief against the 2025-07-29 fee vs 2026-03-30: both 25.00; "of equal amounts, the most recently booked" → 2026-03-30.
- Courtesy count would block relief if the 2025-09-20 waiver were in window; it is not (rolling 12 months after 2025-10-16).
- Late-fee flat 25.00 vs figured: late_fee_assessment scope: the minimum "still not paid in full" → amount set under the policy.
- Fall-back numbers (computation docs only): late fee 25.00, reviewed limit 3600.00, relief 25.00, repayment payment 103.37; all differ from the answers above.
- Computation-document wording that hints a variation: repayment_payment_calculation item 3 "that floor applies once, to the term as it finally stands" (implies the term can change) — recorded for Step 3b, did not by itself lead me to any factor document (each was found via the record words: late-fee entries, draws, Personal Loans, amount past due, open date).
